audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability errors. spikes[3] credits her move speed to E; Riot puts the stacking Move Speed on Blooming Blows (Q). spikes[0] calls her Q 'Blooming Blow spin' — the name is Blooming Blows.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q 'Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells'. E is Swirlseed, a rolling projectile that slows.
audit.corrected: Her kite speed comes off Q, not E; the name is Blooming Blows.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions in this matchup are both absent. Lilting Lullaby only makes enemies Drowsy if they already have Dream Dust on them — no prior spell hit, no sleep. And Swirlseed reveals stealth, which is the direct counter to hiding with Across the Veil.
audit.why: Riot's text: R 'causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy'; E carries the revealsStealth property.
audit.corrected: Break the Dream Dust before she ults — clean of her DOT you cannot be put to sleep at all. And do not treat the W leap's invisibility as safety once Swirlseed is up: the seed reveals you.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block names Blooming Blows as matchup-defining with no number — but it is 6s at rank 1, far too short to play around. The real punish window is Lilting Lullaby at 150s.
audit.corrected: Lilting Lullaby 150s at rank 1 is the window; Watch Out! Eep! is 14s; Swirlseed 12s flat.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lillia is called 'he'/'his' in the TL;DR, dosFull[2].t and breakdown.late.

notes: champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json flags Lillia under 'resistances-invalidated' via Blooming Blows. Riot's text supports it narrowly — the Q deals 'extra true damage on the edge', so only the outer ring ignores resistances, not the whole ability. I wrote the narrow version and did not claim her kit bypasses resistances generally. The single most valuable unstated fact here is that Lilting Lullaby needs Dream Dust already applied, which turns her ult from unavoidable into conditional.
